lines.speaker: cutiesexy
lines.text: - Fear of being stared at? Must have been tough.

lines.speaker: yesman_1
lines.text: - I know how she feels. I get sweaty palms when I know someone's eyes are on me.

lines.speaker: yesman_1
lines.text: - That makes it all the more impressive that she finished her entire routine.

lines.speaker: brainnicebody
lines.text: - Are we sure this isn't all just an act to get attention? It was totally bizarre how she just sat down.

lines.speaker: blinggirl
lines.text: - I say she's just doing this so that she gets in the news.

lines.speaker: braindead_1
lines.text: - I can't believe how rude the crowd was to her.

lines.speaker: partyguam
lines.text: - Who wants to come with me and cheer for Bay? (n/999)

lines.speaker: handsome
lines.text: - A little bit of attention and suddenly she collapses? If you ask me, she needs to toughen up.

lines.speaker: baylove
lines.text: - I'm so happy to see Bay again at the stadium
